name: Jellyfin Federation
description: Aggregate content from multiple Jellyfin servers into unified virtual libraries
overview: The Jellyfin Federation Plugin allows you to create a unified media library by aggregating content from multiple remote Jellyfin servers. Stream content from any server without file synchronization.
changelog:
Fixes a critical bug that could break an otherwise-healthy friend connection from a single unrelated settings save. IssuedApiKey (the federation token this server mints for a friend during the handshake, added in 0.0.70) was missing from the config-save endpoint's preserve-on-save list - every other post-handshake field (FederationId, sharing scope, excluded items, per-user rules) was already protected there, but this one wasn't. Since the config page never receives saved tokens back from the server (by design, so they're never exposed to the browser), any general settings save sent an empty value for it - and with nothing preserving the real one, it got silently wiped. Once wiped, that friend's every request comes back 401 ("the federation token is invalid, missing, or was revoked") - indistinguishable from a genuinely revoked or incompatible-version friend, even though nothing was actually wrong with the connection. Confirmed live: a single config save broke a freshly-established, fully-working handshake this same session. IssuedApiKey is now preserved exactly like every other server-internal field.

214 tests (unchanged).
